There are several reasons why it deserves attention. It can improve employment opportunities and help communities develop. When people understand the main ideas, they can make better decisions and take part more confidently in discussions about the future.

At the same time, the topic has challenges that should not be ignored. However, students do not always have equal access to good teachers, books, or technology. Different communities may experience these difficulties in different ways, so solutions should be based on evidence and local needs.

There is no single answer that works in every situation. Governments, families, and schools can work together to make learning more accessible. Learning about the value of education encourages critical thinking, responsible behaviour, and a better understanding of the world.
